professionalSummary.text: Accountable owner of the card-not-present fraud model for e-commerce merchants in the UK and Ireland from 2022 to 2024, as confirmed by the model risk team.
professionalSummary.witness: the former employer's model risk team confirmed in writing that the model inventory lists the candidate as accountable model owner for the card-not-present fraud model from 2022 to 2024.

experienceHighlights.text: Approved two decline-threshold changes in 2023 after weekly reviews with the fraud operations manager, documented in the model change log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Approved two changes to the decline threshold in 2023 after weekly reviews with the fraud operations manager; both are recorded in the model change log.

experienceHighlights.text: Built velocity and device-consistency features from authorisation data, tested on holdout months, and documented in the feature catalogue.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built velocity and device-consistency features from authorisation data, tested each on a holdout month and documented each one in the feature catalogue.

experienceHighlights.text: Presented half-yearly model performance reviews (detection rate, false-positive rate, alert volumes) to the model risk committee, including threshold history and planned changes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Presented the half-yearly performance review of the card-not-present model (detection rate, false-positive rate and alert volumes) to the model risk committee, with the threshold history and the changes planned for the next half-year.

experienceHighlights.text: Reviewed scoring service latency reports with the platform team, which built and ran the real-time scoring service, and raised tickets for response-time issues.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reviewed the scoring service's latency reports with the platform team, which built and ran the real-time scoring service, and raised two tickets when response times drifted above the agreed limit.
